description: Add or update many products at once, by the same rules as POST /v1/products/import: at most 5,000 rows, each row the fields of create_product. Send `dry_run: true` first: it checks every row and writes nothing. A real import writes nothing while any row has a problem. Each row comes back as create, update, unchanged or conflict.

dry_run.description: true checks and writes nothing. Default false.

name: import_products
title: Import products
